children.value: > Fact From Story The Mombies started out in 2016 when Terry Davis, a Fairfield mom and human resources executive, got together with a group of other moms to surprise the neighborhood with a flash mob on Halloween.
> > Fact From Story "After the first year, she said, ‘Why don't we attach a little bit of goodness to it?’ And we started ‘Dance to Donate,’ which has created this big movement.
> > Fact From Story "She wanted to create a unique surprise for the kids to show them we're fun and to show them that we can be exciting, too," Gavin said.

> > > Fact From Story On Halloween night, the Fairfield Beach neighborhood comes alive as housewives, movie stars, socialites, prisoners, school girls, cheerleaders, soldiers and cooks — all turned to zombies — emerge from ordinary homes and put on a spectacular show.
> > > Fact From Story "We dance four or five times that night or as many times as people show up," Garin said.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Flash mobs are a type of surprise performance.
> > Commonsense Knowledge People often start things to create something unique or exciting.
> Commonsense Knowledge A group of people can start something.
